evidence.behavior_citation: von Philipsborn et al. 2011, Neuronal Control of Drosophila Courtship Song, Neuron 69(3):509-522 (pIP10 command neuron); Shirangi, Wong, Truman & Stern 2016, Doublesex Regulates the Connectivity of a Neural Circuit Controlling Drosophila Male Courtship Song, Developmental Cell 37(6):533-544 (TN1A activates hg1 motoneuron, causal statement); Shirangi, Stern & Truman 2013, Motor control of Drosophila courtship song, Cell Reports 5:678-686 (hg1 motoneuron silencing eliminates sine song specifically)
evidence.confidence_note: Every node AND every functional link in this chain is independently confirmed in prior literature, not just connectivity-inferred -- a stronger evidentiary standard than most other hotspots. One open question flagged, not resolved: dPR1 (a different premotor neuron, functionally classified as 'pulse-promoting') anatomically connects to hg1 MN more strongly than TN1a does, despite TN1a being the literature-assigned relay for this specific muscle. Neuroglancer-confirmed superclasses match expected roles exactly (descending_neuron / vnc_intrinsic / vnc_motor).
